offers.title: Level Designer (Unannounced Project)
offers.description:
We’re looking for a Level Designer to join the team working on a new 11 bit studios unannounced project.

You’ll help us shape a large, diverse world combining a mix of natural environments with human-made spaces, focused on exploration, survival and first-person traversal. We’re looking for someone who enjoys exploring ideas, prototyping solutions and thinking about how to build engaging spaces at scale, rather than only working within already established patterns.

This position requires working in a hybrid model in our Warsaw office.

Your responsibilities:

  • Designing and iterating open-world locations, from early greyboxes to final layouts,

  • Creating natural environments and different biomes that support exploration, clear navigation and first-person traversal,

  • Designing gameplay spaces around survival mechanics, verticality, combat and environmental challenges,

  • Building varied locations using modular and scalable solutions,

  • Shaping both outdoor and indoor spaces, including shelters, abandoned locations and cave systems,

  • Working closely with Environment Art, Tech Art and Game Design to turn prototypes into convincing and performant locations.
offers.requirements:
What will help you succeed in this role?

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Level Design,

  • Strong understanding of first-person (FPP) level design and large-scale/open-world environments,

  • Experience with Unreal Engine and understanding of open-world systems and workflows, including World Partition,

  • Strong greyboxing and prototyping skills,

  • Ability to think systemically and work with modular, set-based design,

  • Good understanding of pacing, scale, composition, sightlines and player navigation,

  • Proactive approach to design, research and problem solving,

  • Good understanding of technical constraints related to large environments,

  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

  • Fluent English.

Experience in another engine is not a blocker if you have strong Level Design fundamentals and are comfortable working & learning with Unreal workflows.

Nice to have:

  • Experience prototyping simple 3D assets in Blender or similar software.

  • Basic Level Art skills, including working with modular kits, materials, collision and asset placement,

What we offer?

  • Health and Wellness

    • psychological support/care

    • private medical package

    • Multisport

  • Development

    • team training budget

    • in-office library

  • Our office

    • near Metro Stadion Narodowy and Dworzec Wschodni stations

    • dog-friendly

    • in-house gym

    • no dress code

    • car and bike parking

    • chill zone

    • video, board and arcade games

  • Working conditions

    • flexible working hours

    • hybrid work (3 days from office, 2 days from home + additional pool of remote days per year)

    • 20 or 26 days of fully-paid holiday leave

    • international working environment

  • Events and more

    • attendance in game dev events

    • relocation budget for candidates from abroad

    • referral program

    • annual company events

    • merch/swag

offers.title: UI/UX Artist & Designer
offers.description:
Companion Group is a AAA co-development gaming studio with a globally distributed and fully remote setup. We are renowned for overcoming the most intricate challenges in multiplayer game development. As the primary choice for clients aspiring to elevate their multiplayer titles, we enable scalability, maximise player density, and craft immersive gameplay experiences.

Embedded seamlessly within our clients’ in-house teams, we collaborate harmoniously to turn dreams into reality. Our portfolio boasts groundbreaking games developed in collaboration with major studios worldwide. As a fully remote studio, we value clear, continuous, and transparent communication as highly as technical expertise.

We are seeking a UI/UX artist to join our Unreal Engine 5 game project. The role requires both artistic, design skills and technical implementation knowledge, with a strong emphasis on building accessible, player-friendly interfaces for Nintendo Switch.

This is for a fixed term contract, however due to the nature of our business there is a likely chance this may be extended or turned into a permanent role longer term.
offers.requirements:
Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement intuitive UI layouts, menus, and HUD elements in Unreal Engine 5.

  • Create UX flows that prioritise clarity, usability, and accessibility for a wide range of players.

  • Follow the given art direction and expend upon its visual identity of the game’s interface, including iconography, typography, and graphic elements.

  • Collaborate with game designers, artists, and engineers to ensure UI/UX integrates seamlessly with gameplay systems.

  • Develop accessibility features such as scalable text, colorblind-safe palettes, control remapping, and audio/visual cues.

  • Produce wireframes, prototypes, and style guides for consistent design and art direction.

  • Optimise UI for performance across platforms without sacrificing clarity or accessibility.

  • Stay current on accessibility standards, best practices, and evolving player needs.

Requirements: 

  • Proven experience designing UI/UX for games, ideally in Unreal Engine 5.

  • Experience level suited for intermediate to senior roles.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing interface design, visual polish, and player-centric workflows.

  • Knowledge of Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG and Nintendo accessibility standards for Switch).

  • Ability to translate complex gameplay systems into clear, usable interfaces.

  • Strong graphic design fundamentals: composition, typography, hierarchy, spacing.

  • Can deliver polished, game-ready elements showcasing strong illustrative instincts (Icon sets, etc.)

  • Proficiency in design tools (e.g., Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator) and Unreal UMG/Slate.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines, time zones, and cultures in a small, fast-paced team.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with motion design or animation for UI transitions.

  • Familiarity with localisation and supporting multiple languages.

  • Knowledge of player research, usability testing, and iterative design.

Benefits:

  • A competitive salary.

  • A clear career progression path with opportunities for growth and recognition.

  • Fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere.

  • Access to mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals in the gaming industry.

  • Be part of a passionate and dynamic team working on exciting, boundary-pushing projects.

Let’s build worlds that inspire and immerse players in the magic of a timeless era. Apply now and become part of one of the best game studios in the world!
